s.note: the Greek diner where they wait tables
s.how: Cut 1kg potatoes into chips and fry twice, first at 140C, then at 185C. Toss while hot with 1 tsp dried oregano, the zest of a lemon, salt and 100g crumbled feta. Squeeze the lemon over just before serving.

Spread 8 slices white bread with Dijon and fill with 200g sliced cheddar. Butter the outsides with 40g butter and griddle over medium heat for 3 minutes a side until golden and melted. Cut into soldiers.

m.how: Grill 8 rashers of bacon. Toast 12 slices bread. Layer 300g sliced turkey, bacon, lettuce and 2 sliced tomatoes with mayo across three slices for each sandwich. Pin with toothpicks and cut into triangles. Serve with potato chips.

w.note: the wedding that might be real
w.how: Beat 200g butter and 200g sugar, add 4 eggs and fold in 200g self-raising flour. Bake in two tins at 175C for 25 minutes. Beat 250g butter with 400g icing sugar, split and tint half pink and half green. Ice and pipe flowers.

d.how: Peel and slice 2 ripe bananas. Blend with 300g Greek yoghurt, 400ml cold milk, 3 tbsp honey and 1 cup ice for 45 seconds until thick and frothy. Taste and add a little more honey if needed. Pour into 4 tall glasses, drizzle each with a little more honey and dust with ground cinnamon. Serve with straws.
